AVENGA BRAND-ROOTED

Ground is Premium Purple #2C1847 — the brand book's own "large solid backgrounds" colour. Text is Visionary White, Trustful Beige and Compassionate Lavender. Creative Red #DD2C00 carries both the mark and the policy-violation semantic.

Emerald (passed) and Amber (HITL) are functional additions — the brand book defines no status colours.

Typefaces stand in for the licensed Avenga faces: Instrument Serif for Reckless, Manrope for Haffer.

REFERENCES, SCREEN BY SCREEN

1 Executive Trust — Stripe Radar's itemised stat columns + Semrush's gauge-beside-trend.
2 Mandate — Vercel project settings / AWS IAM policy generator: a firewall, not a chat box.
3 Continuous Evolution — Cloudflare Observability's range control and timestamped event stream; the evidence panel from theme-analysis.
4 Regulatory Exposure — Vanta Remediation SLAs: severity-banded rows with per-row windows and actions.
5 HITL Gate — Apple Pay / Okta: one decision, zero distraction.

EVERY ARTBOARD IS LIVE — click into one and use it.

1 Switch tracks: metric tiles, sparklines, gauge, chart and all three breakdown columns repaint.
2 Run the integrity probe → the Golden Bridge warning blocks the Mandate → Fix with Avenga Intelligence releases it. Toggle scope paths; cycle the budget dials.
3 Step the FCEE loop on the left — each step swaps the evidence panel on the right. Change the time range.
4 Enforce control plane: four open audit vulnerabilities flip to enforced.
5 Touch the dial to arm, then confirm — a signature is issued. Or reject and void.
